app.name: PropMatch AI
app.slogan: The 1st broker-free smart residential rental marketplace in Mansoura
app.tagline: Smart direct matching between tenants and landlords

common.ownership_disclaimer: Identity verification proves user identity only and does not guarantee legal property ownership.

auth.tenant_role_desc: Looking for a rental home, browse listings or submit a customized housing request for smart matching.
auth.landlord_role_desc: Rent out units directly without brokers, receive serious tenant offers, and generate AI-optimized listings.
auth.login_subtitle: Enter your credentials to access your dashboard
auth.register_subtitle: Enter your information to create an account and get started
auth.forgot_password_desc: Enter your registered email and we will send a verification code to reset your password
auth.already_have_account: Already have an account? Sign In
auth.dont_have_account: Don't have an account? Sign Up
auth.logout_confirm_msg: Are you sure you want to sign out from the application?

validation.phone_invalid: Please enter a valid Egyptian mobile number (e.g. 01012345678)
validation.password_min_length: Password must be at least 8 characters long

tenant.search_hint: Search with natural language or district...

tenant.message_to_landlord_hint: Introduce yourself and why this unit fits you...

landlord.unit_title_hint: e.g. Luxurious furnished apartment overlooking Mashaya
